description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains for stream subscription testing, including Passive_ConsumerGrain, Jerk_ConsumerGrain, and ImplicitSubscribeGrain, along with related observer classes and interfaces.

classes.name: Passive_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that subscribes to streams and counts received items, with methods to start and stop consumption.

classes.name: Jerk_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that unsubscribes immediately upon subscription, demonstrating a 'jerk' behavior.

classes.name: CounterObserver
classes.description: An observer class that tracks the number of items received from a stream.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscribeGrain
classes.description: A grain that implicitly subscribes to multiple streams using stream namespace attributes.

classes.name: ICounterObserver
classes.description: Interface for observer classes that count consumed items.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the grain is activated.

methods.name: GetCountOfOnAddFuncCalled
methods.description: Returns the number of times the OnSubscribed method was called.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of items consumed by all observers.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all stream handles and clears observers.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the grain is deactivated.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles new stream subscription, creating an observer and subscribing to the stream.

methods.name: CounterObserver
methods.description: Observer class that increments count on each received item and logs events.
